Represented by the Ministry of Interior, the UAE participated in a high-level meeting on road safety held at the UN Headquarters in New York. The meeting formed part of ongoing international efforts to enhance road safety, protect road users, and reduce traffic-related fatalities and injuries, The UAE also highlighted its key national achievements in this field, reporting a 74% reduction in road traffic fatalities between 2011 and 2025. حصلت وزارة الداخلية بدولة الإمارات على صفة شريك الحوار (Dialogue Partner) في منظمة الآسيانابول (ASEANAPOL)، المعنية بتعزيز التعاون الشرطي بين أجهزة الشرطة في الدول الأعضاء برابطة دول جنوب شرق آسيا (الآسيان)، لتصبح بذلك أول دولة عربية تنال هذه الصفة، وجاء اعتماد الشراكة بإجماع الدول الأعضاء العشر في المنظمة، خلال أعمال المؤتمر الـ44 للآسيانابول، الذي استضافته الشرطة الوطنية الفلبينية في العاصمة مانيلا خلال الفترة من 22 إلى 26 يوليو 2026، بمشاركة وفود الدول الأعضاء وشركاء الحوار والجهات المراقبة. Represented by the Ministry of Interior, the UAE has been elevated to Dialogue Partner status within ASEANAPOL, the regional body that promotes police cooperation among the member states of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations. The UAE is the first Arab nation to receive this designation. The decision was endorsed unanimously by ASEANAPOL’s ten member states at the organization’s 44th conference, held in Manila from 22 to 26 July 2026 under the auspices of the Philippine National Police. The event brought together representatives of member countries, dialogue partners, and observer entities. #وزارة_الداخلية_الإمارات #فخورين_بالإمارات 🇦🇪 #الامارات_أمن_وأمان #MOIUAE

As part of the ongoing effort to ensure a stable and continuous water supply for civilians across the Gaza Strip, COGAT reached out directly to Gazan residents through its Arabic-language social media page and asked them to report locations where additional water deliveries were needed. Following the many responses received from the civilian population, COGAT reviewed the requests and coordinated with local and international partners to dispatch water tankers to the relevant areas. COGAT remains committed to facilitating humanitarian assistance in coordination with the international community and in direct contact with the public, to help ensure that aid reaches the civilians who need it most.

The visit included the Correctional Institutions Department, the Judgments Enforcement Department, the Police Academy, the Juvenile Police Department, the Police Rescue Department (Al Fazaa), and the Capital Security Department. It aimed to review best practices and exchange expertise in various fields of security and police work. #MOIQatar

The Police Academy celebrated the graduation of the third and fourth groups of the seventh edition of the Police of Tomorrow Program (Summer 2026), with a total of 400 students, in the presence of His Excellency Major General (Staff) Abdullah bin Mohammed Al Suwaidi, Assistant Undersecretary of the Ministry of Interior for Technical and Specialized Affairs; Major General Abdulrahman Majid Al Sulaiti, President of the Police Academy; and Colonel Dr. Fahad Saeed Al Subaie, Vice President of the Police Academy and Director of the Police College, along with a number of Ministry of Interior officers and the students' parents. The ceremony featured demonstrations showcasing the skills and knowledge the students acquired throughout the program, which aims to strengthen national identity, instill the values of loyalty and belonging, develop leadership skills, and foster a sense of responsibility through a range of sports, military, and educational activities. #MOIQatar
